intro: Formal result connectors, and the one of them that takes the subjunctive.
p.de ahí que.consejo: It always takes the subjunctive: «de ahí que no venga». It is the exception among result connectors.
p.de modo que.consejo: With the indicative it expresses a result; with the subjunctive, a purpose: «habla de modo que te oigan».
p.de manera que.consejo: It works like «de modo que»: indicative for a result, subjunctive for a purpose.
p.por consiguiente.consejo: It is formal and takes the indicative. It usually opens the sentence or sits between commas.
p.así pues.consejo: It is more written than spoken. It opens a conclusion: «así pues, no iremos».
p.con lo cual.consejo: It takes the indicative and picks up what came before: «perdí el tren, con lo cual llegué tarde».
p.hasta el punto de que.consejo: It expresses a very strong result and takes the indicative: «hasta el punto de que no pude dormir».
p.luego.consejo: As a logical connector it is «por tanto»: «pienso, luego existo». As an adverb, «later».
p.afueras.consejo: It is almost always plural: «vivo en las afueras». The «fue» sounds «fwe».
p.demanda.consejo: In economics it is what people want to buy. Its partner is «oferta».
p.sueldo.consejo: It is what you earn for your work. «Salario» is almost the same. The «ue» sounds «we».
p.alquiler.consejo: It is masculine: «el alquiler». The verb is «alquilar». The «qu» sounds k.
b1.texto:
Almost all result connectors take the **indicative**: **por consiguiente**, **así pues**, **con lo cual**, **de modo que**, **de manera que**; and **luego**, in a logical deduction.

The exception is **de ahí que** + **subjunctive**. It presents the result as something already known, which the first clause explains: está enfermo; **de ahí que** no **venga**.

**De modo que** and **de manera que** change meaning with the mood:

- with the indicative, a result: llovía, **de modo que nos quedamos**.
- with the subjunctive, a purpose: habla **de modo que** todos te **entiendan**.

Results from intensity: **tan / tanto… que**, **tal** + noun + **que**, **hasta el punto de que**.
b2.f0.texto: Rents have gone up a lot in the centre.
b2.f1.texto: Hence many young people are going to live on the outskirts.
b2.f4.texto: There is such demand for flats that they are let within a day.
b2.f5.texto: Many owners prefer tourists, which means there are fewer flats for residents.
b2.f6.texto: So, we will have to move.
b2.f7.texto: Talk to the owner, so that he understands your situation.
b2.f8.texto: The rent goes up to the point that nobody can pay it.
b4.texto:
**Result with the indicative**: por consiguiente, así pues, con lo cual, de modo que, de manera que, luego.

**Result with the subjunctive**: only **de ahí que**.

**Purpose**: de modo que / de manera que + subjunctive. Compare: llovió, de modo que nos quedamos (result, indicative); habla de modo que todos te entiendan (purpose, subjunctive).

**By intensity**: tan / tanto… que; tal + noun + que; hasta el punto de que.
b4.e1.texto: It was raining, so we stayed at home.
b4.e2.texto: There was such noise that I could not sleep.
b5.f0.texto: The cranes draw dark lines across the sky of the neighbourhood.
b5.f1.texto: On the balconies, the hanging washing moves like white birds.
b5.f2.texto: Rents rise so much that many families look for a home on the outskirts.
b5.f3.texto: Wages, on the other hand, hardly move.
b5.f4.texto: Consequently, the air in the street smells of weariness and haste.
b5.f5.texto: The demand for flats grows so that almost nobody finds an open door.
b5.f6.texto: A woman climbs the stairs with a box of books in her arms.
b5.f7.texto: Her steps echo so much that the whole building seems to listen to them.
b5.f8.texto: So the neighbourhood gradually empties of laughter and voices.
b5.f9.texto: At the end of the street, an old streetlamp lets a yellow light fall.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes: it is the only exception, always with the subjunctive.
b6.o1.refuerzo: It takes the indicative, like almost all result connectors.
b6.o2.refuerzo: It takes the indicative; only «de ahí que» asks for the subjunctive.
b6.pregunta: Which result connector takes the subjunctive?
b7.frase: Está enfermo, de ahí que no ____.
b7.o0.refuerzo: That is it: «de ahí que» always takes the subjunctive.
b7.o1.refuerzo: It is indicative. After «de ahí que» comes the subjunctive.
b7.o2.refuerzo: It is the indicative future. After «de ahí que» comes the subjunctive.
b7.pregunta: Complete with the mood that «de ahí que» asks for.
b8.frase: De ahí que muchos jóvenes se vayan
b8.traduccion: Hence many young people are leaving
b9.o0.refuerzo: A result would be indicative. Here «oigan» is subjunctive.
b9.o1.refuerzo: Well done: with the subjunctive, «de modo que» means «so that».
b9.o2.refuerzo: «De modo que» never expresses a cause.
b9.pregunta: In «habla de modo que te oigan», what does it express?
b10.pregunta: Write in Spanish, with the accent mark: «consequently».
b11.frase: Había ____ ruido que no pude dormir.
b11.o0.refuerzo: Yes: «tal» + noun + «que» expresses a strong result.
b11.o1.refuerzo: «Tan» goes before adjectives or adverbs, not before a noun.
b11.o2.refuerzo: «Ruido» is singular, so it cannot be «tales».
b11.pregunta: Choose the word that goes with a noun.
b12.o0.refuerzo: That is the adverb. Here it is a logical connector.
b12.o1.refuerzo: No: «luego» does not speak of place.
b12.o2.refuerzo: Correct: I think, therefore I exist.
b12.pregunta: What does «luego» mean in «pienso, luego existo»?
p.alquileres.consejo: Plural of «alquiler», rent. The stress is on LE.
p.vayan.consejo: Subjunctive of «ir», to go. The v sounds like b: BA-yan.
p.tal.consejo: Here «tal» means «such». It has one syllable: TAL.
p.alquilan.consejo: From «alquilar», to rent. Stress on KI: al-KI-lan.
p.dueños.consejo: Plural of «dueño», owner. The ñ sounds like ny, and the ue is one syllable: DWE-nyos.
p.prefieren.consejo: From «preferir», to prefer. The ie forms a diphthong: pre-FIE-ren.
p.dejan.consejo: From «dejar», to leave. The j sounds like h: DE-han.
p.tendremos.consejo: Future of «tener», to have. Stress on DRE.
p.mudarnos.consejo: «Nos» at the end means «ourselves». The stress is on DAR.
p.entienda.consejo: Subjunctive of «entender», to understand. The ie is a diphthong.
p.pagarlo.consejo: «Lo» at the end means «it». The stress is on GAR.
p.existo.consejo: From «existir», to exist. The x sounds like ks: eks-IS-to.
p.grúas.consejo: Plural of «grúa». The accent falls on the u, which breaks the diphthong.
p.balcones.consejo: Plural of «balcón», balcony. Stress on KO.
p.tendida.consejo: From «tender», to hang out to dry. Feminine, as it agrees with «ropa».
p.resuenan.consejo: From «resonar», to echo. The ue is a diphthong: rre-SWE-nan.
p.escucharlos.consejo: «Los» at the end means «them». The stress is on LOS.
p.farola.consejo: Feminine, «la farola». Stress on RO: fa-RO-la.
p.enfermo.consejo: Stress on FER: en-FER-mo. It is the opposite of «sano».
p.finalidad.consejo: Ends in -dad, so it is feminine: «la finalidad». Stress on DAD.
p.situación.consejo: The -ción ending is stressed: si-tua-THYON. The c sounds like th.
